updates.rationale: Action-time engine identity prevents retroactive invalidation.
updates.statement: Batch-open records engine version, implementation and source. Foreign checkout engines cannot open batches; batch operations refuse mismatched engines before work, with no repinning. Repository engines pin the batch location; schema-1 batches remain unpinned and members are not pinned.

clauses.reason: Extend COMMIT-CHECK-001 without competing with M1 ownership.

updates.rationale: Preparation may replace hooksPath and runtime cache interpreters disappear on updates.
updates.statement: A stable machine-local commit-check shim uses the installed launcher for Skill engines. Install-or-verify runs after preparation and functionally probes the effective reference-transaction hook. Foreign hooks are preserved and can chain the shim; inactive checks warn in status with the chaining contract. Immutable commit attribution remains the backstop.

decisions.reason: Approved D/E/F2/F3: mutable foreign engines invalidated running validation; cached interpreter hooks disappeared after updates and preparation replaced hooksPath. Pin at batch-open and verify hooks at the effective path. No repinning or bypass; inactive hooks warn because immutable attribution remains the backstop. Repository self-hosting pins location so admitted engine changes remain valid; members remain unpinned. Reopen if launcher stability or functional probing cannot preserve project hooks.
